scenes.speaker: Campus Canteen
lines: A well-known placement coordinator senior invites you to join their project team.
Later behind the lab, they light up: "We smoke before brainstorming. Take a drag if you want to be in the core team."

choices.text: "I'm excited to contribute my coding and design skills to the project, but I don't smoke. Happy to brainstorm inside the lab."
choices.feedback: Flawless professional boundary! True mentorship values talent, not compliance in unhealthy habits.

choices.text: "I have an assignment deadline in 15 minutes, need to head back to the department."
choices.feedback: Smart withdrawal that prevents being cornered in isolated spaces.

scenes.speaker: Project Outcome
lines: The senior respects your work ethic. Your code speaks for itself, and you maintain complete self-respect.
Skills, character, and integrity build lasting careers.
